Specification: This module specifies a trivial system with no constants, variables, or state structure. The initial condition and next-state relation are both defined as TRUE, so the specification can always advance and imposes no actual transition constraints. It also defines an invariant Inv as FALSE, which therefore fails in every state; the comment indicates the module was introduced as a minimal test case related to an Apalache issue.
